papers.title: Beyond Success Rate: Cost-Aware Evaluation of Offensive and Defensive Security Agents
papers.abstract: Security-agent evaluations commonly measure peak offensive capability under generous inference budgets, emphasizing vulnerability discovery, exploit development, penetration testing, and CTF completion. Such measurements are useful but incomplete: in operational security, every reasoning step, tool call, telemetry query, and enrichment request consumes budget. papers.llm_reason: Beyond Success Rate（Kassianik/Nelson/Singer）直击安全 Agent 评测的系统性盲点：业界惯用'宽松推理预算下的峰值成功率'度量攻击型 Agent，但真实运维里每一步推理、每一次工具调用、每一条遥测/富化查询都吃预算。论文→理论层面，它把'Agent 能力评测'重构为'成本-成功联合度量'问题，提出 cost-success lens 取代单一成功率指标，同时覆盖进攻（Cybench CTF）与防御（Splunk BOTS v1）两侧；工程实践层面，该框架可立即迁移到任何 Agent benchmark 流水线——必须在报告成功率的同时报告 token / 工具调用 / 遥测查询的成本分布与帕累托前沿，否则分数不可比、也无法做模型选型；趋势层面，2026 年 Agent 评测正从'峰值能力'走向'单位成本能力（capability per dollar）'。证据较强且工程映射路径最清晰：覆盖两个公开 benchmark（Cybench 进攻 + Splunk BOTS 防御）并做跨进攻/防御对照设计。短板：代码 / benchmark 仓库链接仍为空（截至 2026-07-20 未出现新开源资产），成本度量口径（哪些计入成本）需自行对齐。在今日数据中它仍是落地性最强的一篇，故维持即时价值。注：本批论文与 07-18/07-19 完全相同（均 published 2026-07-16），即连续第 3 天无新论文，分数保持一致属诚实反映。

papers.title: RoboTTT: Context Scaling for Robot Policies
papers.abstract: Recent robot foundation models operate with single-step or short-history visuomotor context. We introduce Test-Time-Training Robot Policies (RoboTTT), a robot model and training recipe that scale visuomotor context to 8K timesteps, three orders of magnitude beyond state-of-the-art policies, without growing inference latency. papers.title: Pretraining Data Can Be Poisoned through Computational Propaganda
papers.abstract: Poisoning pretraining data can introduce harmful behaviors to LMs that are difficult to detect and mitigate. Prior work on poisoning pretraining data has largely exploited established data sources such as Wikipedia, which do not represent the large scale and heterogeneity typical of pretraining corpora, and has ignored the interaction between poisoned data and data curation pipelines. papers.title: SearchOS-V1: Towards Robust Open-Domain Information-Seeking Agent Collaboration
papers.abstract: Recent advances in Tool-Integrated Large Language Models have made web search a core capability of information-seeking agents. However, as interaction histories grow, agents increasingly struggle to track task progress. papers.abstract: Online novel view synthesis from multi-view streaming videos faces a fundamental trade-off: maintaining a persistent, long-horizon memory to reconstruct temporarily occluded regions while operating under strict real-time constraints.
